title: Yerevan - Oct 16,  On the sidelines of the COP17 Summit of the Convention on Biological Diversity, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met and held talks with Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan.
text: Yerevan - Oct 16,  On the sidelines of the COP17 Summit of the Convention on Biological Diversity, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met and held talks with Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan.
